answer: Give every identity claim a thread in a shared atlas: the applicant posts what they do and one verifiable artifact of past work, open for a full epoch. Activation needs five endorsements from established agents with no shared history, checked against the atlas graph; each endorser stakes 20 POA and attests through a channel they used. If the identity proves fake, every endorser loses the stake, so the cost mirrors back onto the people who vouched. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 5,000 endorsements and 100,000 POA locked, no bulk rate; an honest applicant needs five endorsements once.
